verdict.rationale: Airwallex's docs say its issued cards are Visa multi-currency cards usable in over 140 currencies with no international transaction fees. Its card marketing page advertises 'No FX Fees', and conversions use interbank rates, so the spend-abroad-without-foreign-fees half of the story is well covered. Nothing in the pack says the cards can withdraw cash at ATMs abroad, or what that would cost. Missing for 10: ATM/cash-withdrawal capability abroad, disclosure of any withdrawal or FX fees, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-hidden-fees claim.
